chapter: Learning the trombone and jam sessions
title: Faddis and Eubie Blake at Dick Gibson's Colorado party
summary: At Gibson's jazz party in Colorado, 22-year-old Faddis played with 94-year-old Eubie Blake, filmed for a movie.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: That's why I like this thing up at Colorado, you know. He might put you on with anybody. He might put on a swing guy up there with some modern guys. A couple of swing guys. And it's a challenge. You never know who you're going to play with. This last time he had John Faddis playing with Eubie U.B. Blake. John Faddis is 22 and U.B. Blake is 94. And they tore up the house. They played -- they played the most beautiful thing on "Memories of You", the thing that -- it's going to be in the movie -- in that movie he's got.
People were -- we just did a movie up there of this thing.

Yeah, we did a movie of it. And it was the most beautiful thing you ever heard in your life. People were coming out of there crying. I mean many people with tears in their eyes. It was amazing. And here's this guy -- so, Dick got up there and announced. And said, well, when this kid was born Eubie U.B. was 75. It's so funny. It's so funny. You know, you wouldn't think it would work but it did.
It was beautiful. Everybody was talking about them when they came away. That's going to be -- I'm sure that's going to be one of the highlights of the movie. It would have to be. It was amazing.
